# `project.languages.set`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/project.languages.set.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`project.languages.set` (`SetProjectLanguages`): sets the project's languages and its printed formats as one
value, the four fields of the wizard's step 8 (doc 16 §9.2).

- `source` and `translations` become `Project.languages` (`ProjectLanguages`); without `source` the project
  has no languages member (texts are read in their neutral or first language);
- `date` and `decimal_separator` become `ProjectSettings.formatting.date` and `.decimal_separator`; an absent
  value removes the member, so the pinned derivation profile's default applies. The formatting's other
  members (`tag_case`, which decides when tags collide, and members of newer formats) are kept.

Every member is the new value, so an absent one is removed, not kept. Rejected: `translations` without
`source` or containing it, and the same translation twice (at `/translations`); a format of a newer version
(at its pointer). Only the project record changes. Bulk: the date format changes the dates of every title
block. Undoable as one step. Outcome: none.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | [`DateFormat`](#dateformat) or `null` | no |  | The date format of printed dates; absent: the profile default. |
| `decimal_separator` | [`DecimalSeparator`](#decimalseparator) or `null` | no |  | The decimal separator of printed numbers; absent: the profile default. |
| `source` | [`CmdLangTag`](#cmdlangtag) or `null` | no |  | The language texts are authored in; absent: the project names no languages. |
| `translations` | array of [`CmdLangTag`](#cmdlangtag) | no |  | The translation languages (a set; 1.0 content); needs `source`. |

## Types

### CmdLangTag

A canonical BCP 47 language tag such as "en" or "de-CH" (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 2 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:[a-z]{2,3}(?:-[a-z]{3}){0,3}|[a-z]{4,8})(?:-[A-Z][a-z]{3})?(?:-(?:[A-Z]{2}|[0-9]{3}))?(?:-(?:[a-z0-9]{5,8}|[0-9][a-z0-9]{3}))*(?:-[a-wy-z0-9](?:-[a-z0-9]{2,8})+)*(?:-x(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})+)?$`

### DateFormat

Printed date format.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"dd_mm_yyyy"` | dd-mm-yyyy. |
| `"iso8601"` | ISO 8601, yyyy-mm-dd. |

### DecimalSeparator

Printed decimal separator.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"point"` | "0.75". |
| `"comma"` | "0,75". |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).

This is a bulk command: a log line runs it as a preview first and commits the previewed result ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)).
